title: Truck Dispatch & Queue Management Procedure (SOP-DSP-04)
content: Queue time at loading units should remain below 8% of truck operating hours. When queue time exceeds 12% for more than two consecutive shifts, the dispatcher must rebalance truck-shovel assignments and review shovel cycle times.

title: Maintenance Prioritisation Standard (MNT-STD-11)
content: Equipment with a vibration index above 5.0 or more than 8 hours of unplanned downtime in a rolling 7-day window must be scheduled for inspection before the next shift. Safety-critical findings require supervisor sign-off before return to service.

title: Fuel Idle Reduction Guideline (ENV-GL-02)
content: Engines idling longer than 5 minutes in queue consume approximately 25-30 litres per hour. Idle reduction and queue control are the primary levers for fuel intensity improvement.

title: Haul Route Compliance Manual (OPS-MAN-07)
content: Route deviation above 8% of planned haul distance indicates non-optimal routing or road condition issues. Survey road conditions and verify dispatch route assignments before attributing deviation to operator behaviour.

title: Loading Unit Performance Benchmarks (OPS-BM-03)
content: Reference shovel swing-load cycle is 32 seconds for 4100-class shovels in blasted material. Cycles above 35 seconds suggest excess motion, poor fragmentation, or truck spotting issues.

title: Drill & Blast Quality Assurance (DB-QA-09)
content: Re-drill rate should remain below 5% of drilled holes. Elevated re-drill rates are associated with collapsed holes, poor pattern marking, and increased dilution downstream.

title: Incident Escalation & Critical Risk Controls (HSE-PR-01)
content: Critical and high-severity incidents must be investigated within 24 hours. Repeat incidents on the same asset trigger a critical control verification. No automated system may override a safety stop.

title: Continuous Improvement & Frontline Ideas Program (CI-PR-02)
content: Repeat failures without a documented root cause analysis indicate that frontline technician knowledge is not being captured. Each repeat failure should trigger a 5-Why session including operators and maintainers.

title: Stockpile & ROM Pad Inventory Policy (PLN-PL-05)
content: Target ROM stockpile cover is 1.0 to 1.5 shifts of crusher feed. Mining above crusher capacity for sustained periods builds inventory that must be rehandled at additional cost.
